lessons.title: Origins — Yonkers, Abuse, Neglect, Survival

body.text: Goals: Teach context without glamorizing pain. “What pain do you hear in his voice, not just his words?” Build emotional awareness.

body.label: Key points
items: Finding stray dogs as family → the “Dog” persona
Meeting Ruff Ryders → family structure he never had
DMX as a broken kid who became a warrior
